description: EuroCropsML is a labelled Sentinel-2 benchmark for identifying crop types from agricultural parcels. Its README reports 706,683 time-series data points across 176 classes from Estonia, Latvia and Portugal for 2021, based on EuroCrops version 9. Users train or test a classifier on per-parcel median reflectance series; outputs are predicted crop labels or benchmark measures. Geographic coverage is those three countries, not all European farmland. The linked DataCite record for the dataset DOI states CC BY-SA 4.0, while repository code has MIT metadata. A limitation is that class distributions differ strongly among the three regions and the 2021 signal may not transfer to later weather or crop rotations. The dataset can help estimate land use and crop-water demand for agricultural and irrigation scenarios. The related QGIS catalogue platform can analyse parcel layers but is not this labelled benchmark. No imagery or dataset archive was downloaded.
